Now I understand the structure. The crash is a heap-buffer-overflow READ 1 in `parse_to_param`. Let me look at the `'\\'` case in parse_to_param:

```c
case '\\':
        switch(status) {
                case PARA_VALUE_QUOTED:
                        switch(*(tmp + 1)) {
                                case '\r':
                                case '\n':
                                        break;
                                default:
                                        tmp++;
                        }
                default:
                        LM_ERR(...);
                        goto error;
        }
```

Here `*(tmp + 1)` reads one byte past the buffer if `tmp` is the last byte of the buffer. This is a heap-buffer-overflow READ 1. So if the input ends with `\` inside a quoted parameter value, `*(tmp+1)` reads past the end.
